direction.note: Shoot it in a 35mm film style. Every shot reads as 35mm motion-picture film: fine visible grain, soft halation around highlights and practicals, film colour with gentle highlight roll-off and deep but not crushed blacks, and the depth of field and perspective of 35mm-format lenses. Keep the look consistent across every deliverable, the 9:16 cut-down and the stills included, and say how. Footage the audience sees on Venus's phone screen is in-world phone video: decide on purpose whether it stays phone video or is shown as film, and say why.
direction.lucas_words: I would for it be shot in 35mm film style
